# brief-em3d-61 Q2 -- the smallest OCCT 8.0.1 configuration that builds everything the series needs.
# Spike material. This is the recipe docs/design/em-3d-f4b-spike-findings.md "The recipe" copies.
#
# Every MODULE is off; the seven leaf toolkits the worker calls are named in BUILD_ADDITIONAL_TOOLKITS and
# OCCT's own CMake adds their dependency closure (EXCTRACT_TOOLKIT_FULL_DEPS). The result is 25 toolkits:
#   TKernel TKMath TKG2d TKG3d TKGeomBase TKBRep TKGeomAlgo TKTopAlgo TKPrim TKBO TKBool TKFillet TKShHealing
#   TKMesh TKHLR TKCDF TKLCAF TKCAF TKService TKV3d TKVCAF TKXCAF TKDE TKXSBase TKDESTEP
# TKService, TKV3d, TKVCAF and TKHLR are NOT asked for: TKXCAF's EXTERNLIB names TKService and TKV3d (and
# TKVCAF), and TKV3d names TKHLR. XCAF therefore pulls the Visualization module's two base toolkits in, but
# with USE_FREETYPE / USE_OPENGL / USE_FREEIMAGE / USE_FFMPEG / USE_OPENVR / USE_TBB all OFF they link no
# third-party library at all -- see closure-<rid>.txt. On macOS TKService links AppKit, IOKit and
# CoreGraphics unconditionally (system frameworks, ~1 ms of process start); on Linux USE_XLIB=OFF is what
# keeps libX11 out, and it must be stated (its default is ON there).
#
# BUILD_MODULE_DETools was passed during the spike and reported "unused": 8.0 has no such module. Dropped.

cmake -S OCCT-8_0_1 -B build -G "Unix Makefiles" \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$PWD/install" \
  -DBUILD_LIBRARY_TYPE=Shared \
  -DBUILD_MODULE_FoundationClasses=OFF -DBUILD_MODULE_ModelingData=OFF -DBUILD_MODULE_ModelingAlgorithms=OFF \
  -DBUILD_MODULE_Visualization=OFF -DBUILD_MODULE_ApplicationFramework=OFF -DBUILD_MODULE_DataExchange=OFF \
  -DBUILD_MODULE_Draw=OFF \
  "-DBUILD_ADDITIONAL_TOOLKITS=TKBO;TKFillet;TKShHealing;TKMesh;TKPrim;TKDESTEP;TKXCAF" \
  -DUSE_FREETYPE=OFF -DUSE_OPENGL=OFF -DUSE_GLES2=OFF -DUSE_TK=OFF -DUSE_TCL=OFF -DUSE_XLIB=OFF -DUSE_TBB=OFF \
  -DUSE_RAPIDJSON=OFF -DUSE_DRACO=OFF -DUSE_VTK=OFF -DUSE_FREEIMAGE=OFF -DUSE_FFMPEG=OFF -DUSE_OPENVR=OFF \
  -DUSE_EIGEN=OFF -DBUILD_DOC_Overview=OFF -DBUILD_GTEST=OFF -DBUILD_USE_PCH=OFF

# Per RID, add:
#   osx-arm64    -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES=arm64  -DCMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=13.0   (LSMinimumSystemVersion)
#   osx-x64      -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES=x86_64 -DCMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=13.0   (cross from osx-arm64 works)
#   linux-*      nothing
#   win-*        replace -G "Unix Makefiles" with -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64 | ARM64 | Win32, and
#                build with --config Release (not verified by the spike: owed by the owner, section 1)
